name: MetLife Stadium
address: 1 MetLife Stadium Dr, East Rutherford, NJ 07073, USA
home_cs: New York Giants, New York Jets
home_en: New York Giants, New York Jets
desc_cs: Multifunkční stadion v areálu Meadowlands, kousek od New York City.
desc_en: A multipurpose Meadowlands venue just outside New York City.
fact_cs: Bude hostit finále MS 2026 a po dokončení patřil k nejdražším stadionům v USA.
fact_en: It will host the 2026 World Cup final and was one of the most expensive stadiums built in the US.

name: AT&T Stadium
desc_cs: Obří krytý stadion v Arlingtonu se zatahovací střechou.
desc_en: A giant indoor venue in Arlington with a retractable roof.
fact_cs: Proslul obří závěsnou obrazovkou nad hřištěm a běžně pojme výrazně víc lidí než při MS.
fact_en: It is famous for its giant centre-hung video board and normally fits far more fans than in World Cup mode.

name: SoFi Stadium
home_cs: Los Angeles Rams, Los Angeles Chargers
home_en: Los Angeles Rams, Los Angeles Chargers
desc_cs: Moderní stadion v Inglewoodu na místě bývalého Hollywood Parku.
desc_en: A modern Inglewood venue built on the former Hollywood Park site.
fact_cs: Má ikonickou průsvitnou střechu a patří k nejnovějším stadionům turnaje.
fact_en: It features a distinctive translucent canopy roof and is one of the newest venues in the tournament.

name: Hard Rock Stadium
address: 347 Don Shula Dr, Miami Gardens, FL 33056, USA
desc_cs: Multifunkční stadion v Miami Gardens pro NFL i univerzitní fotbal.
desc_en: A Miami Gardens multipurpose venue used for NFL and college football.
fact_cs: Kolem stadionu se jezdí okruh Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix.
fact_en: The Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix circuit runs around the stadium complex.

name: Lumen Field
address: 800 Occidental Ave S, Seattle, WA 98134, USA
home_cs: Seattle Seahawks, Seattle Sounders FC, Seattle Reign FC
home_en: Seattle Seahawks, Seattle Sounders FC, Seattle Reign FC
desc_cs: Hlasitý multifunkční stadion v seattleské čtvrti SoDo.
desc_en: A famously loud multipurpose stadium in Seattle’s SoDo district.
fact_cs: Je známý skvělou atmosférou a hlukem tribun při velkých zápasech.
fact_en: It is renowned for its atmosphere and crowd noise during major matches.

name: Levi's Stadium
address: 4900 Marie P DeBartolo Way, Santa Clara, CA 95054, USA
desc_cs: Stadion v Santa Claře, součást sportovního srdce Bay Area.
desc_en: A Santa Clara stadium at the heart of the Bay Area sports scene.
fact_cs: Hostil Super Bowl 50 a leží asi 64 km jižně od San Francisca.
fact_en: It hosted Super Bowl 50 and sits about 64 km south of San Francisco.

name: Arrowhead Stadium
address: 1 Arrowhead Dr, Kansas City, MO 64129, USA
desc_cs: Klasický stadion v Kansas City, známý výjimečnou kulisou.
desc_en: A classic Kansas City venue known for its exceptional atmosphere.
fact_cs: Patří mezi nejslavnější stadiony amerického fotbalu díky rekordní hlučnosti publika.
fact_en: It is one of the most famous NFL venues thanks to record-setting crowd noise.

name: NRG Stadium
desc_cs: Stadion v Houstonu se zatahovací střechou a velkým eventovým zázemím.
desc_en: A Houston venue with a retractable roof and major event infrastructure.
fact_cs: Byl prvním stadionem NFL se zatahovací střechou.
fact_en: It was the first NFL stadium with a retractable roof.

name: Lincoln Financial Field
address: One Lincoln Financial Field Way, Philadelphia, PA 19148, USA
desc_cs: Domov Eagles v South Philadelphia Sports Complex.
desc_en: The Eagles’ home in the South Philadelphia Sports Complex.
fact_cs: Leží v srdci velkého sportovního areálu jižní Filadelfie.
fact_en: It sits in the middle of South Philadelphia’s major sports complex.

name: Mercedes-Benz Stadium
address: 1 AMB Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30313, USA
desc_cs: Moderní stadion v Atlantě se zatahovací střechou ve tvaru okvětních lístků.
desc_en: A modern Atlanta venue with a petal-like retractable roof.
fact_cs: Uvnitř má slavný 360° halo videoprstenec a otevřel se v roce 2017.
fact_en: It features a famous 360-degree halo video board and opened in 2017.

name: Gillette Stadium
home_cs: New England Patriots, New England Revolution
home_en: New England Patriots, New England Revolution
desc_cs: Víceúčelový stadion ve Foxborough mezi Bostonem a Providence.
desc_en: A multipurpose Foxborough stadium between Boston and Providence.
fact_cs: Kromě Patriots je dlouhodobým domovem i New England Revolution.
fact_en: Besides the Patriots, it has long also been home to the New England Revolution.

name: BMO Field
address: 170 Princes' Blvd, Toronto, ON M6K 3C3, Canada
desc_cs: Městský stadion v areálu Exhibition Place v Torontu.
desc_en: A city-owned venue at Exhibition Place in Toronto.
fact_cs: Stojí na místě bývalého Exhibition Stadium a pro MS dostane rozšířenou kapacitu.
fact_en: It stands on the former Exhibition Stadium site and gets an expanded capacity for the World Cup.

name: BC Place
address: 777 Pacific Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6B 4Y8, Canada
desc_cs: Velký krytý stadion ve Vancouveru na břehu False Creek.
desc_en: A large covered Vancouver venue on the edge of False Creek.
fact_cs: Je známý svou zatahovací střechou a hostil i finále MS žen 2015.
fact_en: It is known for its retractable roof and also hosted the 2015 Women’s World Cup final.

name: Estadio Azteca
address: Calz. de Tlalpan 3465, Sta. Úrsula Coapa, Coyoacán, 04650 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
desc_cs: Legendární fotbalový stadion v Coyoacánu v Mexico City.
desc_en: A legendary football stadium in Coyoacán, Mexico City.
fact_cs: Hostil finále MS 1970 i 1986 a je největším stadionem v Latinské Americe.
fact_en: It hosted the 1970 and 1986 World Cup finals and is the largest stadium in Latin America.

name: Estadio BBVA
address: Av. Pablo Livas 2011, colonia La Pastora, C.P. 67140, Guadalupe, Nuevo León, Mexico
desc_cs: Moderní fotbalový stadion v Guadalupe v metropolitní oblasti Monterrey.
desc_en: A modern football-specific venue in Guadalupe in Greater Monterrey.
fact_cs: Přezdívá se mu El Gigante de Acero, tedy Ocelový obr.
fact_en: Its nickname is El Gigante de Acero, the Steel Giant.

name: Estadio Akron
address: Circuito J.V.C. 2800, El Bajío, 45014 Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico
desc_cs: Stadion v Zapopanu u Guadalajary, využívaný hlavně pro fotbal.
desc_en: A stadium in Zapopan near Guadalajara used mainly for football.
fact_cs: Je domovem Chivas a dříve byl známý jako Estadio Omnilife a Estadio Chivas.
fact_en: It is home to Chivas and was previously known as Estadio Omnilife and Estadio Chivas.
